newsitem.title: INDONESIA: GT Petrochem signs $300 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: GT Petrochem signs $300 mln loan.

text.p: Indonesian petrochemical company PT GT Petrochem Industries said on Monday a wholly-owned subsidiary GTPI Netherlands B.V. had signed a $300 million syndicated term loan facility with 22 financial institutions.
GT Petrochem said in a statement the loan would be used to strengthen its financial performance and expand production.
The loan facility had a tenor of five years with amortization starting at the end of the third year and an interest margin of 0.98 percent over SIBOR, it said.
Lead arrangers included Banque Paribas, The Sanwa Bank Limited and the Fuji Bank Limited, it said.
GT Petrochem, a member of the Gajah Tunggal Group, is a tyre cord and industrial filament manufacturer.
